says: In next/, ProcessTable.outbound still returns a process watcher's watches on processes that already exited, so when that watcher exits, ProcessManager writes demonitored {reason: "watcher_exited"} for monitors whose DOWN already fired, the same second end that ticket 979 fixed for held(session); in OTP a monitor that fired is gone.
proof: Process.ts:691-695 filters outbound on _tag === "live" and the recipient only, while held at Process.ts:703-707 also requires this.isLive(process); ProcessManager.ts:350 calls watcherExited(turn, table.outbound(process), from) on every exit, and processTable.laws.test.ts:455 expects outbound to keep watches on exited processes, so the law pins the asymmetry.
cost: Each exit of a process that watched an already-exited process writes a false watcher_exited fact into the processes stream, and outbound and held disagree on what a held watch is.
